title: Donate
description: Donate to support Bay Area Youth Conservation workshops, clean ups, and youth climate education.

header.heading: Support youth-led climate action.
header.body: Your donation helps Bay Area Youth Conservation run workshops, organize local clean ups, and make climate education more accessible to young people.

donation.heading: Donate through Hack Club Bank.
donation.body: Bay Area Youth Conservation accepts donations through our Hack Club Bank page.

details.heading: Help cover community education.
details.body: Donations can support workshop supplies, printed materials, and youth-friendly climate education resources.

details.heading: Support local volunteer projects.
details.body: Contributions help with clean-up materials and the practical costs of organizing environmental service events.

details.heading: Make participation easier.
details.body: Funding helps students turn ideas into local action without having to cover every cost themselves.

closing.heading: Need donation information first?
closing.body: Send us a note if you have questions about donations, sponsorship, or how funds will support BAYC.
